definition: Passively take a muscle to the point of tension and hold the stretch for a minimum of 30 seconds.

exercises.name_ar: إطالة مثنيات الفخذ من وضع الركوع

coaching_notes: Static stretching is used to decrease muscle spindle activity of a tight muscle before and after activity.
The source notes that contracting the antagonist can enhance relaxation through reciprocal inhibition.
The source warns that acute static stretching immediately before exercise may reduce maximal strength and power temporarily.
